none: 五万分一地形圖 [臺湾] -- 1:50,000 chikeizu [Taiwan], Maps Index

This polygon shapefile is an index to 1:50,000 scale maps of Taiwan, titled 'Gomanbun no ichi chikeizu.' To create this index, footprints were generated using the fishnet tool, and metadata were supplied for the digitized paper maps by Stanford University Libraries. After the footprints were created, the shapefile was trimmed and labeled according to the sources.
This item is in the public domain.  There are no restrictions on use.
This work is in the Public Domain, meaning that it is not subject to copyright.
